data.name: Seshu
data.gender_notes: Seshu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Seshu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sesha', which means 'the endless one'. This name is given to the deity Lord Vishnu in his form as the serpent Ananta Shesha, who supports the universe on his infinite coils. Seshu is also a name for the sage Markandeya, who was granted immortality by Lord Shiva. The name Seshu carries the meaning “God of the cycles” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Tamil. Parents who choose Seshu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the cycles and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the infinite cycle of creation and destruction in the universe, and the importance of remaining connected to the divine during all phases of life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Seshu holds profound cultural significance in Hinduism, representing the ideals of continuity, eternity, and protection. Lord Ananta Shesha is often depicted as the celestial serpent mass of endless coils, supporting the universe as it spins on its axis. The concept of an all-encompassing, eternal being present at the foundation of the universe offers great symbolism and metaphysical depth. Naming a child Seshu is believed to bestow upon them the blessings of the infinite deity for success, prosperity, and endless happiness in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Seshu is profound, encapsulating the essence of unending spiritual evolution. The name evokes the power and presence of Lord Ananta Shesha, implying the promise of protection, sustenance, and spiritual growth throughout the various stages of life. The child is believed to embody the endless potential for growth and evolution, with the blessings of the divine protection accompanying them on their spiritual journey. The name Seshu serves as a constant reminder of the infinite possibilities and the power of the divine in guiding and supporting one's path.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Seshu, meaning 'eternal' in Sanskrit, symbolizes the eternal and infinite cosmic consciousness that continuously nurtures and sustains the universe. It is the divine force beyond the illusion of time and space, representing the ultimate reality beyond the transient physical world.
